title: Up over 100% since March! Multibagger small-cap stock to be in focus on Monday; here’s why
summary: Standard Engineering plans to acquire a 51% stake in GScale Energy for ₹190 crore, marking its entry into AI data-centre infrastructure. The investment is part of a ₹500 crore program focusing on growth and capacity expansion in this emerging market.
